name: scheduler
description: Open-source, self-hostable scheduling for teams. A Calendly alternative you can run inside your company.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @scheduler/server" "npm run dev -w @scheduler/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @scheduler/web && npm run build -w @scheduler/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
